data.one_liner: A customizable, cross‑platform chat UI widget set for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready‑made chat components like message lists, input composer, and avatars. It is backend‑agnostic and can be themed or extended with builder functions.
use_when: You need a full‑featured chat interface without building UI from scratch
You want a backend‑agnostic solution that works on mobile, web and desktop
avoid_when: You require a tightly integrated backend SDK (e.g., Firebase specific)
You need a lightweight single‑widget solution rather than a full UI kit
strengths: Highly customizable theme and builder APIs
Modular design lets you replace parts easily
weaknesses: Relies on several other packages (material_ui, flutter_chat_core) increasing bundle size
No built‑in backend integration, you must provide your own data layer
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_chat_core and flutter_chat_ui to pubspec, then import and use the Chat widget; no native platform setup required.
